name: Kimi AI (www.kimi.com)
description: Kimi AI assistant web app — chat with streaming answers, in-chat internet search, file/image upload, long-context mode. .cn mirror: kimi.moonshot.cn (login host login.moonshot.cn); canonical is www.kimi.com.
author: ui2api capability package
siteVersion: Connect RPC on notilo.kimi.com/apiv2 — 411 methods / 45 protobuf services decoded from 99 JS bundles (~12MB); chat = ChatService.Chat (server-stream), search = kimi.chat.v1.Tool.Search{force} + search.v2.SearchService, files = POST /apiv2-files/file/upload

transport.protocol: Connect (connect-es v2) over HTTP POST; protobuf frames on the stream; no WebSocket for chat
transport.protoContext: request/response are Connect-wrapped protobuf messages (e.g. kimi.gateway.chat.v1.ChatRequest → stream<ChatResponse>); exact frame/binary payload layout NOT yet captured

auth.refresh: AuthService.RefreshToken{refresh_token} → rewrites both keys; Code.Unauthenticated → cleanToken + logout

headers.x-msh-shield-data: optional TrustDecision(同盾) blackbox via window._fmOpt.getinfo() — page-injected, may be required once abuse signals appear

transport.streaming: server-streaming: ChatService.Chat returns a Connect HTTP stream of ChatResponse which the client slices into kimi.chat.v1.Block / TextBlock / message_ref segments; ResumeChat marks isStreaming=false and auto-resumes dropped chunks

capabilities.name: Chat
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the composer; streamed answer off the page (ChatService.Chat server-stream on notilo.kimi.com/apiv2)
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)
capabilities.implementation: ChatService.Chat (kimi.gateway.chat.v1) server-streaming POST /apiv2/kimi.gateway.chat.v1/ChatService/Chat; ChatRequest carries chat_id, kimiplus_id, scenario (enum CHAT=1/THINK=2/DEEP_RESEARCH=3/…), tools, message (kimi.chat.v1.ChatMessage), options{thinking, reasoning_effort, context_length, model(10)}. Payload field layout NOT yet verified on the wire — a later incarnation may call it directly via page fetch + protobuf; the DOM path below drives the SPA.

capabilities.name: Web search toggle (in-chat internet mode)
capabilities.description: Flip the composer web-search switch so the answer is grounded by live search (feeds kimi.chat.v1.Tool{type:TOOL_TYPE_SEARCH, search{force}} on ChatService.Chat)
capabilities.implementation: In-chat search is a tool on the chat RPC: Tool{type:kimi.common.v1.ToolType.TOOL_TYPE_SEARCH=1, search{force}}. Per-message citations via ChatService.GetSearchCitation{chat_id,message_id} + GetToolBlock; dedicated backend search.v2.SearchService.{Search, SearchImage, SearchSaas, SerpSaas, Highlight, Rerank, Url2Text, GetPdfMeta} exists but is NOT what the composer switch drives. Toggle DOM unverified.

capabilities.name: Conversation history list
capabilities.description: List past chats (ChatService.ListChats / ListMessages); DOM sidebar fallback
capabilities.method: in-page Connect RPC or DOM sidebar read
capabilities.implementation: ChatService.ListChats (kimi.gateway.chat.v1, mirrored in kimi.chat.v1) returns kimi.chat.v1.Chat{id, name, labels, pinned, last_request, status, model, timestamps}; chat brief = ChatBrief{id,name,labels}. No thread-search RPC exists in the inventory — client-side filter on ListChats or sidebar DOM. Payload layout to be verified on first live capture.

capabilities.name: File / image upload support
capabilities.description: Attach documents or images to a chat — REST multipart POST /apiv2-files/file/upload (FileService.Upload) with parse tracking (GetFileParseProgress, ListChatFiles)
capabilities.method: in-page REST multipart (Bearer access_token) or composer attach UI
capabilities.implementation: POST https://notilo.kimi.com/apiv2-files/file/upload (multipart formData, responseType text) + lightweight POST /file/upload_simple; kimi.gateway.file.v1.FileService.Upload (client-streaming), GetFileParseProgress, ChatService.ListChatFiles; image blob host https://kimi-img.moonshot.cn. Parse errors REASON_KIMI_FILE_PARSE_JOB_FAIL / REASON_KIMI_FILE_MODERATION_FAIL. Attach UI DOM unverified; recipe pending first live capture.
capabilities.notes: Upload flow details to be verified on first live capture; recipe pending

capabilities.name: Long-context / long-context-only mode
capabilities.description: Set context_length / context-length-only mode on ChatRequestOptions (kimi.common.v1.ContextLength) for long-input answers
capabilities.method: composer mode toggle or ChatService.Chat options
capabilities.implementation: ChatRequestOptions has thinking (bool, K3 mode), reasoning_effort (kimi.common.v1.ReasoningEffort), context_length (kimi.common.v1.ContextLength); frontend state key selectContextLength drives the picker. Exact ContextLength enum codes + toggle DOM NOT decoded — to be verified on first live capture.
capabilities.notes: Toggle DOM + exact ContextLength codes to be verified on first live capture; recipe pending

auth.note: Auth is localStorage access_token (replayed as Bearer on notilo.kimi.com/apiv2, plus site-internal x-msh-shield-data TrustDecision header). Refresh via AuthService.RefreshToken; on Unauthenticated cleanToken() logs out. Exact cookie set TBD on first live capture.

permissions: requires a real logged-in Kimi session snapshot (access_token in localStorage)
anti-bot: TrustDecision(同盾) blackbox + VolcanoEngine analytics on the page — no synthetic inputs, use the site's own JS paths
quota/captcha gates may fire on abuse signals (QUOTA_EXCEEDED_WINDOW_5H/7D, REASON_ACCOUNT_CAPTCHA_VERIFY_FAILED)
analysisMethod: static JS-bundle analysis (see CAPABILITIES.md — 99 bundles / ~12MB, 411 RPC methods / 45 services); no browser launched; no RPC payloads yet verified on the wire
